title: Contrastive learning
reading: The slide frames supervised classification as an instance of contrastive learning: the objective is to maximize similarities between positive pairs while minimizing similarities between negative pairs.

concepts.name: Contrastive learning
concepts.why_it_matters: Framing learning as pulling positives together and pushing negatives apart unifies supervised and self-supervised objectives.

concepts.name: Positive and negative pairs
concepts.why_it_matters: They define what the similarity objective rewards and penalizes.

concepts.name: Supervised classification
concepts.why_it_matters: Used as the familiar case reinterpreted contrastively.
